episodes.synopsis: A shy girl from Mercury enrolls in the prestigious Asticassia School of Technology and immediately bumps heads with top student Miorine Rembran.
episodes.title: The Witch and the Bride

episodes.synopsis: Before Suletta can take in her victory, she's surrounded and taken into custody on suspicion of utilizing forbidden GUND Format technology.
episodes.title: The Cursed Mobile Suit

episodes.synopsis: Miorine insists on helping Suletta in her rematch against Guel. But with his pride in tatters, Guel has no intention of losing a second time.
episodes.title: Guel's Pride

episodes.synopsis: Much to everyone's entertainment, Suletta panics and flees when Guel suddenly proposes to her. But Chuchu from Earth House isn't amused at all.
episodes.title: Unseen Trap

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to uncover the Aerial's secrets, Peil Technologies orders Elan to investigate Suletta, who gets flustered when he invites her on an outing.
episodes.title: Reflection in an Icy Eye

episodes.synopsis: Ahead of her duel with Elan, Suletta feels confused about his change of attitude. Her housemates help her augment the Aerial for better mobility.
episodes.title: A Gloomy Song

episodes.synopsis: When Suletta receives an invitation to a social event for new business startups, she decides to attend in hopes that Elan will also be there.
episodes.title: Shall We Gundam?

episodes.synopsis: Miorine wastes no time recruiting her housemates for her new company that will handle Gundams, but they must first decide on a business plan.
episodes.title: Their Choice

episodes.synopsis: Miorine rejects Shaddiq's business offer and challenges him to a duel. They agree on a team battle, but her side lacks mobile suits and pilots.
episodes.title: If I Could Take One Step Toward You

episodes.synopsis: It has been two months since the duel with Shaddiq. Little by little, the launch of GUND-ARM, Inc. is proceeding on track.
episodes.title: Circling Thoughts

episodes.synopsis: The Earth House members arrive at Plant Quetta to retrieve the refurbished Aerial. Suletta worries about the misunderstanding between her and Miorine.
episodes.title: The Witches from Earth

episodes.synopsis: Suletta has to change her attitude if she's going to save Miorine and everyone else. Meanwhile, Miorine and Guel will fight to survive.
episodes.title: Keep Marching On Instead of Running Off
